goal: Den I128-defaultSelection-Vertrag browserlokal implementieren: stabile Option-ID-Referenzen, single/multi-Auswahl, Preview, Remove-/Typwechsel-Guards und Fokussemantik. Keine Persistenz.

guide_delta.summary: Choice-Felder erhalten eine rein temporäre Standardauswahl. Einfachauswahl nutzt genau eine Option, Mehrfachauswahl mehrere stabile Option-IDs; ausgewählte Optionen können nicht still gelöscht werden.

tests_required: Step 1: compile browser_shell.py, test_browser_shell.py and test_i132_default_selection.py
Step 1: selected-option removal must be blocked before mutation
Step 1: multi-to-single with more than one default must be blocked before datatype mutation
Step 2 after green: add focused real Chromium evidence at 100/150/200 percent for selection, reorder-preservation, remove guard, focus and overflow

full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
risks: default selections must use stable option IDs rather than mutable labels
reordering options must preserve semantic selection while changing preview order
selected options must not disappear through remove or type narrowing
new controls must remain keyboard/focus safe at narrow widths
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: choice fields carry a temporary default selection in browser memory
preview displays active choice defaults by labels in current option order
selected options are protected from silent removal and invalid type narrowing
real Chromium evidence covers the new default-selection flow at 100/150/200 percent
product denominator remains 20 of 132 because I132 completes the already counted defaultSelection capability
